faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to common questions about choosing and buying coffee for home, cafes, and businesses.

arabicaRobusta.question: Is Arabica better than Robusta?
arabicaRobusta.answer: Arabica and Robusta differ in flavor, aroma, caffeine content, and cup characteristics. The right choice depends on your taste, brewing method, and the coffee experience you are looking for.

espresso.question: What is the best coffee for espresso?
espresso.answer: The right coffee for espresso depends on your preferred flavor, intensity, and blend. Different Arabica and Robusta combinations can create different espresso experiences.

caffeine.question: Which type of coffee has more caffeine?
caffeine.answer: Robusta generally contains more caffeine than Arabica. If you prefer a coffee with higher caffeine content, you can explore blends with a higher percentage of Robusta.

chooseCoffee.question: How do I choose the right coffee for me?
chooseCoffee.answer: Choosing the right coffee depends on your preferred flavor, caffeine level, brewing method, and how you plan to drink it. If you are not sure, the Farajahan Coffee Finder suggests products close to your taste with a few short questions.
chooseCoffee.linkLabel: Find your coffee with the Coffee Finder

cafe.question: What type of coffee is suitable for a cafe?
cafe.answer: Choosing coffee for a cafe depends on the menu, customer preferences, consumption volume, and desired blend. Explore Farajahan's coffee selection for cafes.

business.question: What options are available for buying coffee in bulk?
business.answer: For businesses with higher coffee consumption, choosing the right blend and package size is important. Farajahan offers coffee products designed for different business needs.

coffeeFinderPage.metaTitle: Coffee Finder-Which Coffee Should I Buy?
coffeeFinderPage.metaDescription: Answer a few short questions about brewing method, strength and flavor to find the right coffee for home, cafe or office, and add it straight to your cart.

intro.title: How do you choose the right coffee?
intro.text: The Farajahan Coffee Finder asks a few short questions and compares our products with your answers. For home use it asks about your brewing method, strength, favorite flavors and budget. For cafes it considers the type of service and monthly consumption, and for offices the number of people. At the end it shows up to three products close to your taste, and you can add them to your cart right there.

arabica.title: Arabica or Robusta?
arabica.text: Arabica is usually milder and more aromatic, has less caffeine and sometimes tastes fruity and sour. Robusta is stronger and more bitter, has more caffeine and crema, and is a common choice for espresso and milk-based drinks. Farajahan products range from 100% Arabica to 100% Robusta, with blends in between. If you are not sure which you prefer, start with a "balanced" strength.

grind.title: Brewing method and grind size
grind.text: The grind size should match your brewing method: coarser for a French press and finer for espresso. On the home bean pages you can choose the grind: whole beans, Moka Pot, home espresso machine, filter machine, French Press, AeroPress, Chemex, V60 or other. If you choose your brewing method in the Coffee Finder, the matching option is selected for you and you can change it later.

how.question: How does the Coffee Finder suggest products?
how.answer: Your answers are compared with each product's features: Arabica-to-Robusta ratio, flavor, pack size, type of service and price per kg. The product that matches your answers best is shown first, with the reason for the suggestion next to it.

login.question: Do I need to sign up to use it?
login.answer: No. You can use the Coffee Finder and place an order without signing in. Signing in with your mobile number is optional.

otherMethod.question: What if my brewing method isn't listed?
otherMethod.answer: Choose "Turkish coffee and other methods". Once you reach the results, you can also change the grind on the product card.

cafePack.question: What pack size is suggested for a cafe?
cafePack.answer: The pack is chosen based on your monthly consumption. Usually a 1 kg bag is suggested for low consumption, the 5 kg special blend for medium consumption, and the 15 kg commercial blend for high consumption.

wholesale.question: Where do I place a wholesale order?
wholesale.answer: In the "Wholesale & Distribution" path, the sales team's phone number is shown instead of product suggestions, because wholesale prices and terms depend on volume and product type. You can also reach us from the Contact page.

story.p1: With more than 12 years of experience in coffee processing, our company officially registered as "Ghahveh Gostaran Sanat Shargh" in 1398 (Solar Hijri) and began its activity under the Farajahan brand.
story.p2: The company's active research and development system plays a key role in producing world-class, health-oriented products.
story.p3: Quality has always been a priority in our policy. Relying on up-to-date knowledge and international experience in the coffee industry, we work to draw a clear vision for the years ahead, one in which we can satisfy the taste of those who love the unique aroma and flavor of coffee.
